subject.title: [Feishu] "This reply completed without visible content" fallback incorrectly triggered for long/markdown-heavy replies (regression from #87896)

question: Is the issue's session-level telemetry enough to promote a repair now, or should maintainers require live Feishu or trajectory proof that shows where the long markdown final disappears before coding?
rationale: Source confirms the fallback path but not the failing layer, and choosing the wrong layer could either hide real empty-turn warnings or add another silent-drop path.

options.title: Require live or trajectory proof first
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu transcript/log evidence or run a maintainer Feishu reproduction that shows assistant final text, delivery attempts, failed counts, and the fallback trigger before repair.

options.title: Allow a guarded source investigation
options.body: Permit a repair worker to add a focused regression harness only if it first reproduces the zero-final long-markdown path without broad fallback-policy changes.

recommendation.title: Require live or trajectory proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu transcript/log evidence or run a maintainer Feishu reproduction that shows assistant final text, delivery attempts, failed counts, and the fallback trigger before repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged fallback repair commits make this the strongest owner signal for deciding proof sufficiency and safe fix shape.
